messages.author: c45e2f67c4021206
messages.subject: Question about gene methylated
parts:
Hi,
How differentially methylated CpGs got from MethylKit package be annotated to genes. Annotation to genic regions is mentioned clearly, but not to genes. How can someone get the gene name? Any other compatible package? Is there any direct option to get a gene name?
Thank you in advance,
Barsha

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Question about gene methylated
parts:
you can use findOverlaps with or findNearest from GenomicRanges package. Annotation to specific genes is not difficult. genomation package also does some of the tasks.

Best
Altuna
